title: Luminous Marsh: Cooperative Rescue

foundation.history: A forgotten submerged civic bell once protected reeds and peat, until recurring bioluminescent flooding forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Ena Rowan, a responder, must coordinate multiple rescue teams, relying on role synchronization despite bioluminescent flooding.
central_conflict: a cascading emergency threatens the submerged civic bell by restricting reeds and peat.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: bioluminescent flooding destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a cascading emergency contests access to reeds and peat
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The submerged civic bell becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Open council administers reeds and peat
Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
